method: OpenJDK11 javap -c -p on original archived compiled classes, inspected beside recovered source. Disassembly retained externally, no original bytecode redistributed.

scope: Confirms these two rules also exist in bundled binaries; does not recover JAWAS1.2.3 or prove equivalence to the paper.
